en.headline: 16-year-old girl critically ill with influenza A and septic shock
en.dek: The patient with chronic illness developed fever on 15 August and was transferred to the paediatric intensive care unit at United Christian Hospital; CHP says flu activity remains high.
body: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a severe paediatric influenza A case involving a 16-year-old girl with chronic illness. She developed fever on 15 August and shortness of breath on Tuesday, prompting attendance at the Accident and Emergency Department of Tseung Kwan O Hospital. She was transferred to the paediatric intensive care unit at United Christian Hospital because of breathing difficulty and low blood pressure.

A respiratory specimen tested positive for influenza A (H3). The clinical diagnosis is influenza A complicated by severe pneumonia and septic shock. She remains in critical condition. Preliminary investigation found no travel history during the incubation period and no symptoms among household contacts.

CHP Controller Dr Edwin Tsui said Hong Kong entered the influenza season in late June and has recorded 10 severe paediatric cases so far this season, including one death. He expected influenza activity to remain high in the coming weeks, with possible further rises in infections and severe cases. The predominant viruses are influenza A (H1) and A (H3), with no evidence of increased severity or antiviral resistance.

zh.headline: 16歲少女感染甲型流感併發嚴重肺炎及敗血性休克 情況危殆
zh.dek: 有長期病患少女8月15日起發燒，今日氣促送院，轉聯合醫院兒童深切治療部；衞生防護中心指流感活躍程度仍高。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心正調查一宗兒童感染甲型流感的嚴重個案，涉及一名有長期病患的16歲少女。她於8月15日起發燒，星期二出現氣促，被帶到將軍澳醫院急症室求醫，因呼吸困難及低血壓被轉送基督教聯合醫院兒童深切治療部留醫。
呼吸道樣本證實對甲型H3流感病毒呈陽性，臨床診斷為甲型流感併發嚴重肺炎及敗血性休克，目前情況危殆。初步調查顯示少女在潛伏期內沒有外遊，家居接觸者暫時沒有病徵。
中心總監徐樂堅表示，本港自6月底進入流感季節，累計錄得10宗兒童感染流感的嚴重個案，除1宗死亡外，其餘有康復、情況穩定及危殆個案。他預期未來數周流感活躍程度維持高水平，感染及嚴重個案可能繼續增加。本地主要流行甲型H1及H3流感，未發現病毒株引致更嚴重疾病或對抗病毒藥物產生抗藥性。
